name: cursor-skill-creator
description: Cursor pack with a bundled workflow skill, evaluation toolkit, and reusable helper subagents for adapting external skill material into installable Cursor-native packs and bundled skills.
author: felipeblassioli

lite.description: Installs the bundled skill-creator workflow and helper subagents without persistent project rules.

strict.description: Installs the same workflow plus project-only guidance for disciplined intake, decomposition, and evaluation loops when authoring packs and bundled skills.

notes: Strict installs add persistent project guidance for adapting source material into bundled skills and packs.
User installs skip rules because Cursor user rules are managed in settings rather than a ~/.cursor/rules directory.
This bundled skill is pack-scoped and is not listed in skill-registry.json unless intentionally promoted.
